class.name: SfxClip
class.brief_description: One audio (or synthesized) segment of an [SfxEvent] or [SfxAutomation].
class.description: [member offset]/[member length] place it on the timeline (seconds) or on the automation's parameter axis (its units); [member stream_offset] is where playback starts inside the stream.

members.member: The opening or closing piece of a longer sound: never shifted by [member SfxEvent.start_fraction].
When its automation leaves it: [code]true[/code] stops it (through its track's release), [code]false[/code] plays out the lap it is in.
Gain over the clip's local time (timeline) or parameter value (automation).
Gain over the time left to the clip's end (timeline - a looping clip fades out only when stopped) or towards [member offset] + [member length] (automation).
Its span from [member offset]; 0 is the stream's own length. On a timeline it also cuts the stream short.
Its start on the timeline (seconds) or the parameter axis.
Shift used by a [member SfxAutomation.phase_locked] automation.
Pitch over the clip's local time or parameter value.
What it plays. An [AudioStreamGenerator] needs [member generator_playback].
Seconds into [member stream] where playback starts.
Its mixer track; [member SfxEvent.master_track] when unset.
Whether it starts with the timeline or when the event is released.

constants.constant: Starts when the instance's time reaches [member offset].
Starts when the instance is stopped without [code]immediate[/code] - a tail.
